lessons.title: Scientific Inventions, Famous Scientists and Lab Tools
lessons.description: Discoveries, Nobel laureates (Aziz Sancar), test tubes, microscopes

questions.rule:
• Inventions vs. Discoveries:
- Invention (İcat): Creating something new that never existed before (e.g. Telephone by Bell, Light bulb by Edison).
- Discovery (Keşif): Finding something that already existed in nature (e.g. Gravity by Newton, Radium by Marie Curie).
• Lab Equipment: Microscope, test tube, magnifying glass, safety goggles, beaker, lab coat.
• Famous Scientists:
- Aziz Sancar: Won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry (DNA repair mechanisms).
- Nikola Tesla: Alternating current (AC) electricity.
- Albert Einstein: Theory of relativity.
• Verbs: Conduct an experiment, explore, invent, discover, cure diseases, design.
questions.examTip: LGS question alert: Pay attention to the difference between 'invent' (olmayan şeyi icat etmek) and 'discover' (doğada var olan şeyi keşfetmek)! Penicillin was discovered, the telephone was invented!

questions.prompt: Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015 for his studies on _____.
questions.explanation: Aziz Sancar hücrelerin hasar gören DNA'ları nasıl onardığını haritalandıran çalışmalarıyla Nobel Kimya Ödülü kazanmıştır.

questions.prompt: Which laboratory tool is used to examine tiny microorganisms that cannot be seen with the naked human eye?
questions.explanation: Gözle görülemeyen mikroskobik canlıları incelemek için mikroskop (microscope) kullanılır.

questions.prompt: Alexander Fleming invented gravity when an apple fell on his head.
questions.explanation: False! Isaac Newton yerçekimini keşfetmiştir; Alexander Fleming ise penisilin antibiyotiğini keşfetmiştir.

questions.prompt: Scientists wear safety goggles in the laboratory to _____.
options: protect their eyes from dangerous chemical splashes
questions.explanation: Laboratuvarda koruyucu gözlük (safety goggles) gözleri tehlikeli kimyasallardan korumak için takılır.

questions.prompt: Thomas Edison _____ the electric incandescent light bulb in 1879.
questions.explanation: Ampul insan yapımı yeni bir alet olduğu için 'invented' (icat etti) kullanılır.

questions.prompt: Match scientists with their fields of work:

matchingPairs.right: Radioactivity and discovery of Polonium & Radium

questions.prompt: Which of the following actions is NOT done in a scientific laboratory?
questions.explanation: Laboratuvar yemek pişirme yeri değildir; güvenlik kuralları gereği orada yemek yemek kesinlikle yasaktır.

lessons.title: 🏆 Unit Trophy Exam: Science LGS Comprehension & Vocab
lessons.description: LGS MEB scientific text reading and achievement analysis exam

questions.prompt: "Scientists are currently working on developing artificial intelligence and finding cures for chronic illnesses like cancer." What is the main goal of these scientists?
options: Improving human health and technological capabilities
questions.explanation: Bilim insanlarının amacı insan sağlığını iyileştirmek ve yapay zeka ile teknolojiyi geliştirmektir.

questions.prompt: A space rover is sent to Mars to collect soil and rock samples. What is the purpose of this mission?
options: To explore if there were signs of past life on Mars
questions.explanation: Mars araçları gezegenin jeolojisini ve geçmişte yaşam izi olup olmadığını araştırır.

questions.prompt: Scientists carry out test trials and research in order to _____ diseases.
questions.explanation: Tıp alanındaki araştırmalar hastalıkları tedavi etmek (cure) içindir.

questions.prompt: Which equipment is used to measure the temperature of a boiling liquid in a lab experiment?
questions.explanation: Sıvıların sıcaklığını ölçmek için termometre kullanılır.

questions.prompt: A telescope is an instrument designed to make distant celestial objects, such as stars and planets, appear nearer and larger.
questions.explanation: True! Teleskop uzaktaki yıldızları ve gezegenleri yakından incelemeyi sağlar.

questions.prompt: Which Turkish scientist was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015 alongside Paul Modrich and Tomas Lindahl?
questions.explanation: 2015 Nobel Kimya Ödülü sahibi Türk bilim insanı Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar'dır.

questions.prompt: Match verbs with their science-related noun partners:
What does a robotic engineer do?
options: Designs, builds and programs robots to perform automated tasks
Sells fruit in a grocery store
questions.explanation: Robot mühendisi robotik sistemleri tasarlar, inşa eder ve programlar.
